title: 3 Filipinos in ICU with 1 critical after Houthi strike on Riyadh airport; no deployment ban, says DMW
summary: Three of the four Filipinos injured after a Houthi strike at Riyadh’s airport in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) remain in intensive care units (ICU), according to Department of Migrant Workers…

blocks.text: Three of the four Filipinos injured after a Houthi strike at Riyadh’s airport in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) remain in intensive care units (ICU), according to Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac. Of the three, one is currently in critical condition.
